    Check system requirements for using GROBID

    grobid_check_requirements.Rd

    Performs a complete diagnostic of the execution environment: operating system, R version, Internet connection, Docker availability and connectivity to one or more remote GROBID servers configured by default. The diagnostic ends with a recommendation of the most suitable operating mode ("docker" or "remote"), but this is not mandatory.

    Usage

    grobid_check_requirements(
  verbose = TRUE,
  check_docker = TRUE,
  check_remote = TRUE,
  test_all_urls = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    verbose

    logical(1) Display a formatted report in the console. Default: TRUE.

    check_docker

    logical(1) Include the check of Docker availability (installation, daemon startup, active GROBID container). Default: TRUE.

    check_remote

    logical(1) Test connectivity to the remote servers configured by default (.checkrefr_env$remote_default_url). Default: TRUE.

    test_all_urls

    logical(1) If TRUE, tests all URLs configured for each mode ("crf" / "full") even after finding a first reachable URL. If FALSE, the function stops testing as soon as a reachable URL is found. Default: TRUE. For details concerning the GROBID model type ("crf" / "full") see the documentation of grobid_process_file().

    Value

    A list (returned invisibly) containing the following fields:

    os

    character(1) Detected operating system ("windows", "macos", "linux" or other).

    os_version

    character(1) OS version detail.

    r_version

    character(1) R version used.

    internet_available

    logical(1) Internet connection detected.

    docker_installed

    logical(1) Docker is installed.

    docker_running

    logical(1) The Docker daemon is running.

    docker_version

    character(1) Docker client version, or NA if not installed.

    grobid_container_active

    logical(1) A GROBID container is currently active.

    grobid_container_id

    character(1) Identifier of the active GROBID container, or NA otherwise.

    remote_default_reachable

    logical(1) At least one default remote server is reachable.

    remote_reachable_urls

    list named by mode ("crf", "full") of character vectors of reachable URLs.

    recommended_url

    character(1) Recommended remote URL, or NA if none is reachable.

    recommended_remote_mode

    character(1) Mode associated with the recommended URL ("crf" or "full"), or NA.

    current_mode

    character(1) Mode currently configured in the package's internal environment.

    current_url

    character(1) Currently configured URL.

    recommended_mode

    character(1) Recommended global mode: "docker", "remote" or NA if no mode is available.

    See also

    grobid_install_guide(), grobid_docker_check(), grobid_server_info(), checkrefr_set_defaults()

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Full diagnostic with console report
grobid_check_requirements()

# Silent diagnostic, without Docker check
req <- grobid_check_requirements(verbose = FALSE, check_docker = FALSE)
req$recommended_mode
} # }
